list.title: Campaigns

cancelDialog.description: Canceling stops dialing and cancels every queued call and remaining recipient. This can't be undone.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteDialog.description: This removes the campaign and its recipient list. Calls it already made stay in your call logs.

create.description: Pick who calls and from which number — everything else can change later.

calls.emptyDescription: Calls appear here as the campaign dials. Start the campaign to begin.

settings.locked: This campaign has finished — settings are read-only. Duplicate it to run the same setup again.
settings.basicsDescription: The agent doing the talking and the number on the caller ID.
settings.scheduleDescription: An optional window — dialing starts and stops on its own.
settings.hoursDescription: When the campaign is allowed to dial. Outside these windows it simply waits.
settings.hoursCustomDescription: Set specific days and times for this campaign.
settings.pacingDescription: How hard the campaign pushes, and what counts as worth another try.
settings.variablesDescription: Campaign-wide values for the agent's placeholders. Per-recipient values override these.
settings.variablesPickAgent: Pick an agent first — its declared variables appear here.
settings.variablesNone: This agent has no variables to set per campaign. Built-ins like {contactName} and {businessName} are filled automatically on every call.
settings.variablesPlaceholder: Fallback for recipients without their own value
settings.variablesHint: A recipient with no value for a variable, here or on its own row, is skipped rather than called. The agent's own default is never used for campaign calls.

retryDialog.reopens: This campaign is completed — retrying reopens it and dialing resumes on the next tick.
retryDialog.endPassed: The end date has already passed, so the campaign will complete again without dialing anyone. Extend or clear the end date first.
